title: Representation by a simulated configuration
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-tape Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, let $v,x$ be finite Boolean strings, let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $v$, and let $d$ be a configuration of the simulator on input $x$. Say that $d$ represents $c$ if there is a natural number $i\leq |v|$ such that $d$ is the simulated encoding of $c$ using index $i$ and phase “work” with no Boolean value and flag true when the input-head position of $c$ is $0$, and phase “ask” otherwise; moreover, if $c$ is nonhalting, then $i$ equals its input-head position minus one.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-tape Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols
$d$ is a simulator configuration on input $x
When $c$ is nonhalting, $i=c$’s input-head position minus one
